name: nativephp/mobile-starter
description: The skeleton application for NativePHP for Mobile.

nativephp/mobile-camera.description: iOS: hand back camera-roll HEIC photos as JPEG so Sunny can make thumbnails and every browser can show them
iOS: drop the microphone and location permission strings and the location code that needs them, since Sunny never records video or geotags photos
Android: drop RECORD_AUDIO, ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION and the shortService foreground service, since Sunny only takes and picks photos and the system camera app doesn't need the service

nativephp/mobile-local-notifications.description: Android: drop the Play-restricted USE_EXACT_ALARM and SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM permissions and fall back to an inexact alarm when exact alarms aren't allowed, instead of throwing a SecurityException

nativephp/mobile.description: iOS: keep the tab bar on pushed screens so it doesn't pop back in after a swipe back
Android: follow symlinks when zipping the app bundle so symlinked path-repo plugins (sunny/item-scanner) ship in vendor
Android: make the persistent boot wait for a cold-path background task runtime so an overdue task firing at launch doesn't crash PHP startup (NativePHP/mobile-air#646)
iOS + Android: honor display-mode and scroll-behavior on tab screens so they get large titles (NativePHP/mobile-air#633)

iOS: ship a PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy declaring the required-reason APIs the PHP runtime, NativePHP and its plugins use, the account data and content Sunny syncs to sunnyhome.app, and the crash and diagnostic data NativeWatch collects
iOS: build the app icon from the Icon Composer file set in nativephp.ios_icon so iOS 26 gets the Liquid Glass light, dark and tinted variants
iOS: when a screen hides the tab bar, keep the bottom bar's inset on the page so the last field can scroll clear of a pinned button

iOS + PHP: let a screen replace the whole navigation stack (replaceStack) and redraw the stack root when its address changes, so logging out leaves nothing to go back to and a replace at the root is not dropped

nativephp/mobile-secure-storage.description: Android: declare the secure storage functions as context-only so a cold-boot background task (sunny:sync) can read the Sunny token

nativephp/mobile-scanner.description: Android: depend on Guava so ScannerActivity compiles once mobile-ui's emoji picker pulls Guava in at runtime only

nativephp/mobile-share.description: iOS: present the share sheet from the top-most view controller, so it opens from a bottom sheet instead of UIKit refusing it (scratchpad issue #14)

nativephp/mobile-ui.description: iOS: focus outlined/filled text inputs when their padded box is tapped (upstream issue #19 in our scratchpad)
iOS: keep a cover-fit image's overflow from swallowing taps meant for the fields around it
iOS: give a :menu pressable's Menu its a11y-label and a11y-hint, so icon-only menus aren't read as a bare pop up button (upstream NativePHP/mobile-ui#202)
Android: center a :menu pressable's content, so items-center and justify-center work like they do without a menu
iOS: let a fit bottom sheet scroll when its content is taller than the sheet can be, instead of cutting off its top and bottom

victorycodedev/toastkit.description: iOS: have VoiceOver read a toast out when it appears, since it draws in its own window that VoiceOver never moves to
iOS: move a toast's action buttons under the message at accessibility text sizes, so the message doesn't break letter by letter beside them
